title: `voids/plenitude-void` cites Schwitzgebel (2008) for two-way introspective error, but his peripheral-vision case is a confident over-estimate of richness drawn from the page's own check-and-find loop; it answers subjective inflation, which it introduces with Rahnev's psychophysics, as a mere economy; and Bronfman's attention-free ensemble claim stands without Jackson-Nielsen, Cohen & Pitts (2017)
